subject: english
title: The Empty Lot
parent_tip: Ask: if you could tell a friend one sentence, what is it?

blocks.p: Behind Lena's apartment building was an empty lot full of weeds, broken bricks, and old cans. Lena pictured it full of tomatoes and sunflowers instead.
"That's too much work for one kid," her neighbor Mr. Diaz said when she told him her idea.
Lena decided to start small anyway. On Saturday she filled two bags with cans. On Sunday she pulled weeds. The next weekend, Mr. Diaz came outside with a rake.
By June, twelve neighbors were working together. In August, they shared a picnic in the new garden. Mr. Diaz raised his fork. "To Lena," he said, "who started with two bags of cans."

items.ask: What is this story mostly about?
choices: A girl collects cans to earn money.
A girl starts a garden, and her neighbors join her.
A man teaches children how to grow tomatoes.

items.ask: Why did Lena start with only two bags of cans?
Write the big idea of the story in one sentence.

answer_key: 1. B (A girl starts a garden, and her neighbors join her.)
3. Sample: Lena started cleaning the empty lot by herself, and soon her neighbors helped her make a garden.
